connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.0: migrated to the new site animeunity.at (animeunity.so is down). New server-side source: discovery from the home feed and /filter catalogue, search via /filter?keyword=, details from the title page, episodes from /ajax/episode/list, streams resolved through the server link-id chain (/ajax/server -> /embed/source -> HLS). Stream candidates are gated by the site's own sub/dub server type, so a variant only resolves when the source actually offers it.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
